title: Advance Durable Goods Orders (Oct 2026 data) — 8:30 a.m. ET on the Wednesday before Thanksgiving, into a triple-booked slot
source: CENSUS: two primaries fetched direct 2026-09-06 by this event's initial research. census.gov/manufacturing/m3/release_schedule.html (HTTP 200, 53,177 bytes) decodes to "October 2026 | 11/25/2026 | 12/3/2026" (advance report, then full report); census.gov/economic-indicators/calendar-listview.html (HTTP 200, 91,396 bytes, 179 rows) reads "Advance Report on Durable Goods--Manufacturers' Shipments, Inventories, and Orders | November 25, 2026 | 8:30 AM | October 2026", release id A202611250830. Promoted estimate -> confirmed per the no-self-confirm limit's named condition: the flip is made by the event's own initial research, not by the sweep that discovered it — identical treatment to the sibling durable-goods-2026-09-25 / -2026-10-27 / -2026-12-23 entries. confirmed describes the published schedule as of 2026-09-06, not immunity from a later re-dating.
notes: DISCOVERED during the thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05). This calendar tracked the September, October and December releases of this series and had NO November entry. CORRECTED 2026-09-06 by this event's initial research (docs/research/events/durable-goods-2026-11-25.md, leg 2): the original entry title and note called the date 'pulled forward onto the Wednesday before Thanksgiving', implying a displacement. It is the series' STANDING Thanksgiving-week slot — six archived copies of these same two Census pages show the October-reference advance report scheduled on the Wednesday before Thanksgiving in 2019-11-27, 2020-11-25, 2021-11-24, 2022-11-23, 2023-11-22, 2024-11-27 and 2025-11-26, i.e. 7 of 7 sourced years. The mechanism is arithmetic: a steady-state ~25-day publication lag plus a fourth-Thursday holiday puts the slot inside Thanksgiving week every year. (The 2025 row is the scheduled date; the 2025 lapse moved Oct-2025 data to 12-23 and that Wednesday carried the delayed September report instead.) What IS distinctive survives the correction: the 8:30 a.m. ET slot is triple-booked with pce-2026-11-25 and gdp-q3-2026-second-2026-11-25 (both high impact, both confirmed), with beige-book-2026-11-25 later that day and, per the same Census calendar, New Residential Sales and Preliminary U.S. Imports for Consumption of Steel Products at 10:00 a.m. The consequence recorded in the thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27 ledger: this corridor is front-loaded onto a single Wednesday session, then a full NYSE closure (11-26), then a 1:00 p.m. ET half session (11-27), then the FOMC communications blackout opening 11-28 — so a move on Monday 2026-11-30 has at least five competing explanations before it has any one of them. Measured by the initial research and new to this calendar: that Wednesday's realized range runs 0.588x (SPY, n=32, 1994-2025) / 0.743x (QQQ, n=26) of its own trailing-250-session median, against an ordinary-Wednesday control of 1.026x / 1.003x. Impact stays medium, matching its sibling entries; symbols is empty.
